children.heading: Technical assistance and agreements
children.text: With respect to any grant recipient or other organization, the Administrator may—
offer technical assistance and training; and
enter into contracts and cooperative agreements.

children.heading: Coordination of programs
children.text: The Administrator may facilitate the coordination of programs between a grant recipient and other organizations and entities.

tree.heading: Training
tree.text: The Administrator may provide training to any representative designated by a grant recipient in—

children.text: mediation and facilitation, direct service, assessment and evaluation; or
any other activity related to the purposes of the Program.
